## Checklist
- [ ] `node scripts/validate-content.mjs` passes
- [ ] Oracle-specific facts are checked against an official source, and that source is listed in the lesson's `sources`
- [ ] Text is my own words (nothing copied from Oracle docs or other sites)
- [ ] Explanations stay simple enough for a 10-year-old (see docs/CONTENT_GUIDE.md)
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`) under the [DCO](https://developercertificate.org/)
- [ ] No third-party code, fonts, images or text added (or its license is compatible and recorded in `REUSE.toml` and `NOTICE`)
- [ ] If app-shell files changed: `VERSION` in `sw.js` is bumped, and `CHANGELOG.md` is updated
